performance_summary: The U-Net model achieved an IoU of 97.68% and Dice Coefficient of 98.82% on held-out paddy test plots, with Precision of 99.97% and Recall of 97.70%.
scientific_disclaimer: This segmentation model is strictly designed for paddy canopy coverage delineation and field stress segmentation. It does NOT estimate 3D heap volume or paddy mass; volume estimation is executed by the photogrammetry pipeline.
